correctness.rationale: From the exact Heuer–Striker prefix halfspaces, every length-k normal has norm sqrt(k). First-row/column inequalities give upper bounds 1/(n+sqrt(n)) and 1/(m+sqrt(m)); uniform r entries attain both. Forced equalities and explicitly strict perturbation witnesses prove the exact dimension and generic facet-contact laws in every shape, including one-row and 1-by-1 boundaries. Matching uniqueness follows independently from coordinate and sum facets. 128 independent finite LP checks and rank/contact tests passed; experiments are corroborative only.
